data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Collette holds deep meaning. Its derivation from the word ‘collette’ - ‘little dove’ - suggests a connection to the biblical figure of the Holy Spirit descending upon Jesus in the form of a dove. The dove is a symbol of purity, peace, and the divine presence in the world. In this way, bearing the name Collette can serve as a reminder of one's connection to the divine and the importance of maintaining purity and grace in one's life.
